resources.string: Floating time — follows the device time zone. This behavior is preserved when editing.
Silent, inexact Android notifications. Battery settings can delay delivery. No exact-alarm permission is requested.
Notifications are disabled. The event is saved; allow Agenda notifications in Android settings to receive reminders.
A clear day. Tap + to add an event.
No events in the next 90 days. Your local calendar is ready, even offline.
No matching events in this year. Change the selected date to search another year.
Sync incomplete. Cached events and pending changes are preserved. Open settings to retry.
Server rejected authentication or access. Check your account settings. Local data is preserved.
Server conflict — your version is preserved
Nothing was overwritten. Export your version, or keep it as an isolated local copy and reload the server version.
Keep local copy, use server version
This preserves your version in a separate local calendar, then accepts the current server version (or its deletion). It does not overwrite the server.
This invitation or calendar structure cannot be edited safely here. Use the original calendar client. Its original ICS is preserved.
Custom time zone: dates, times and time zone locked. Text remains editable.
Imported series: dates and times locked. Text edits affect only the main event.
Imported recurrence preserved; edit it in the original client.
Adding recurrence is unavailable for this imported event.
Imported reminders preserved; edit them in the original client.
This resource cannot be verified as an event in this calendar with a safe server revision. Editing is disabled; the cached event is retained.
The embedded time zone differs at the requested date. The event was not changed. Choose another time or use the original client.
A sync attempt is pending. Editing is locked until it is reconciled so a lost response cannot cause data loss.
This edits the whole series, not just this occurrence.
Delete this event? For recurring events, this deletes the entire series. Synchronized deletion is queued until the server confirms it.
Check the title, time zone and dates. When changing times, end must be after start. Ambiguous or nonexistent daylight-saving times are not accepted.
Action could not complete. Your existing data has been retained.
This event changed while the editor was open. Nothing was overwritten. Copy your notes, go back and reopen the latest version.
Some events use unsupported data or exceed the recurrence limit. Their original ICS remains stored; they are not silently deleted.
Connect directly to your CalDAV server. No Google account or Android calendar access is used.
WARNING: HTTP sends your password and calendar data unencrypted. Only literal loopback or private LAN IP addresses are allowed. Use HTTPS whenever possible.
No event calendars found. Check the endpoint or enter a direct calendar URL.
Discovery failed. Check the URL, credentials, TLS certificate and server permissions. Redirects to other origins are not followed.
Changing the server or username is blocked while this account is attached. Synchronize pending changes first, then detach while retaining local copies.
Disconnect this account without changing anything on the server? All cached events become isolated local calendars. Pending changes must be synchronized first.
Pending or conflicting changes must be reconciled before detaching.
Private local storage · one CalDAV account · open-source libraries. No analytics, ads, system calendar access or account service.
All-day end date is exclusive (the first day not included).
This event is no longer available.
No calendars are visible. Select a calendar in the menu.
This event has changed. Go back and reopen it before editing or deleting.
Some reminders could not be prepared or delivered. Check notification permission and the affected events, then retry.
Authentication refused (HTTP 401). Check the account credentials. Cached events and pending changes are retained.
Access refused (HTTP 403). Check calendar permissions on the server. Cached events and pending changes are retained.
The secure connection could not be verified or established (TLS). Check the certificate and device date; do not bypass security. Cached events and pending changes are retained.
Connection interrupted or server unreachable. Check the connection and retry. Cached events and pending changes are retained.
The server returned an unexpected HTTP response. Sync is incomplete; cached events and pending changes are retained.
The response is partial, unreadable or unsupported. One event can block the calendar update. No deletion is inferred from this response; cached events and pending changes are retained.
A server revision differs, or a write could not be safely reconciled. The pending version is retained; review it before retrying. No forced overwrite was made.
A local change could not be reconciled after the sync attempt. Cached data and unconfirmed changes are retained. Retry before editing it.
The saved account could not be read or does not match the cached calendars. Sync stopped; cached events and pending changes are retained. Check account settings.
Background sync could not be scheduled. Cached events and pending changes are retained. Retry from settings.
These deletions await server confirmation. The original event remains cached; a pending deletion is not itself a conflict.
These cached events cannot be displayed in the selected range. This does not mean they are deleted or in conflict.
Some events exceed the safe recurrence work or density limit in this range. Display is incomplete; original ICS and pending changes are retained. Try a shorter range or the original client.
Some events use recurrence rules or exceptions not supported here. Display is incomplete; original ICS and pending changes are retained. Use the original client for these events.
Some cached event data or time zones cannot be read safely here. Display is incomplete; original ICS and pending changes are retained. Use the original client; no deletion is requested.
Some hourly series cross a clock change or use an embedded time zone. Their times cannot be expanded safely here. Original ICS and pending changes are retained; consult the original client.
